verses.1: And the sons of Israel, according to their number: the heads of the fathers, the leaders of the thousands, and the leaders of the tens and hundreds. They served the king in everything that was required of them. Every new month brought new tasks and responsibilities for everyone. Each month made up one-tenth of a year; there were forty-four months in total.
verses.2: In the first part of the month, Rehovan rules over Bnei Zvidiel. In his part, there are forty-four thousand people.
verses.3: From the sons of Peraz, for all the leaders of the tribes, in the first month.
verses.4: And for the second new part, there are Dodi Ha’ahomi and his descendants. And for the part related to Miklot HaNagid, there are forty-four thousand.
verses.5: The leader of the third congregation in the third month was Nayahu, son of Yehoyada. The priest was the head of his group. There were forty-four thousand people in his group.
verses.6: He is the son of Givor HaShloshim, and his division is Amizavad Beno.
verses.7: On the fourth day of the month, Elohim, my brother Yoav, and Zvadia, his son, built a structure. On that structure, they placed forty-four thousand people.
verses.8: The fifth day of the month; the fifth day of the week. The name of this day is Yizra’ah. On that day, there are forty-four thousand people who participate in the ritual.
verses.9: The sixth month is the month of Ira ben Ikesh. The territory under his control includes forty-four thousand people.
verses.10: The seventh day of the month, the seventh day of the month, is the day when the Philistines were freed from the children of Ephraim. And on that day, forty-four thousand people were saved.
verses.11: The eighth day of the month: I was struck by lightning on that day. And on its branches, there were forty-four thousand lightning bolts.
verses.12: The seventh day of the month: This is the day of redemption for my right-hand son. On that day, forty-four thousand will be sacrificed.
verses.13: The fiftieth day of the month: the fiftieth day of March. It’s a day of celebration and joy. On this day, there are forty-four thousand people who participate in this celebration.
verses.14: Ten tribes for ten new tribes. They were created from the descendants of Ephraim. And for their divisions, there were forty-four thousand.
verses.15: The twelfth year of the twelve years since the beginning of the new year. The cost for Haldai Netofati was one hundred and forty-four thousand.
verses.16: And concerning the rulers of Israel, I will say to Eliezer son of Zichri, “Hear my words!” And I will judge them according to their deeds.
verses.17: To Levi, the son of Camuel, for Aaron Tzadok.
verses.18: To Judah, Elihu, from the brothers of David: to Isachar Amri, son of Michal.
verses.19: Lizbulun shall hear him, son of Obadiah. Nafthali will raise him up, son of Azriel.
verses.20: The trees of Ephraim will save the son of Azaziel; he will reign for half a week. He will be the son of Pedaiah.
verses.21: To the half of Manasseh, Gileadah; to Zechariah’s son. To Benjamin, Yaishiel; to Abner’s son.
verses.22: Ladan Azarael, son of Yeroham, these are the rulers of Israel.
verses.23: And David did not rise from their ranks until he was forty years old. For Jehovah said that Israel would multiply like the stars in the sky.
verses.24: Yovav, son of Zeruya, began to multiply and not stop. This caused anger among the Israelites. But his number wasn’t counted among those recorded in David’s reign.
verses.25: And on the treasures of King Azmaveth, son of Adiel; and on the treasures in the fields, in the cities, in the villages, and in the fortresses. And on the treasures of Jehonatan, son of Uziya.
verses.26: And help those who work in the fields to till the land. Help me, son of Klowb.
verses.27: And on the vineyards, I hear their mournful cries. And on those vineyards, my beloved daughters are weeping bitterly.
verses.28: And upon the trees and shrubs that are in the forest, over Al-Hanan al-Ghadri, and upon the fruits of the trees.
verses.29: And in the mornings, those who are evil will be punished by the judgment of the Lord. And in the mornings, those who are wicked will be punished accordingly.
verses.30: And upon the garments, O’Bil Hishmelei; and upon the ornaments, Yehdyahu the Renoites.
verses.31: And on the sheep, the shepherd will take away all these treasures that belong to King David.
verses.32: And Jonathan, the father of David, was a wise man and a teacher. And Hezekiah, son of Chachmoni, was also among the sons of the king.
verses.33: And Ahithophel advised the king, but Hushai was the enemy of the king.
verses.34: And after his death, Jehoiada will be known as the son of Nathaniah. He will also become the leader of the army for King Joab.
